verdict.rationale: Runloop's Snapshots explicitly support rolling back Devbox state to a known good point, and Blueprints let you version/reuse startup configurations, giving a rudimentary rollback mechanism for agent environments. However, there is no evidence of a review workflow (diffs, approvals, audit trail) or of 'automations' as a first-class versioned object distinct from raw disk/environment snapshots. Missing for 10: explicit review/diff tooling for automations, first-class automation versioning (not just devbox/environment snapshots), audit/history UI for changes.
